title: Moon Over the Western Rocks, Second Attempt

content.question: Is the moon a different colour when it rises over the western rocks than when it is high above the beach?
content.method: I sat on the flat rock at the edge of the western shore just after dusk, where the moon comes up low, and watched it for a long time without blinking more than I needed to. I did not move. Then I climbed the slope to the lamp post and watched it again from above, which is the better place to watch from.
content.result: Low over the rocks it looked pale and slightly rusted, like an old coin left in the rain. Higher up, from the slope, it looked cleaner and closer to white with a faint warm edge. I am not sure the rocks were the cause, but I noticed it, and I am keeping the note.
